text.p: RIGA, May 27 (reuter) - These are the main news headlines reported by Radio Latvia on Tuesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- The meeting of the Baltic presidents continues in Tallin today, concentrating on regional security issues and EU and NATO enlargement. They are joined by their Polish and Ukrainian counterparts.
- Baltic railway companies and the CIS railway council meet in Tallinn today.
- Finance Minister Roberts Zile meets World Bank representatives to discuss a possible $25 million credit line for rural infrastructure development.
